title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,401–3,450 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Real estate near convenient metro stations tends to retain value strongly.
examples.zh: 緊鄰捷運站出口、生活機能完善的捷運宅房地產往往具備極佳的保值性。

examples.en: He decided to invest in commercial real estate after selling his tech startup.
examples.zh: 在賣掉創立的科技新創公司後，他決定將資金投資於商用不動產市場。

examples.en: The real estate market cooled down following government regulations on speculation.
examples.zh: 在政府祭出各項打擊短期炒作的房市調控措施後，房地產市場逐漸降溫回歸理性。

words.definition: 社會住宅；合宜平價住宅

examples.en: The city built modern affordable housing projects to support young families.
examples.zh: 市政府積極推動興建高品質現代化社會住宅，以減輕年輕青年成家居住負擔。

examples.en: Expanding the supply of affordable housing is a key priority for urban planners.
examples.zh: 擴大平價社會住宅的整體供給量是當前都市規劃者亟需解決的重中之重。

examples.en: Qualified low-income residents can enter a lottery for subsidized affordable housing units.
examples.zh: 符合資格條件的弱勢低收入市民可以參加抽籤，申請入住享有租金補貼的合宜公宅。

examples.en: The friendly landlord agreed to replace the aging living room air conditioner.
examples.zh: 隨和親切的房東答應在房客入住前將客廳老舊耗電的舊冷氣全數汰換為一級能效變頻。

examples.en: Always notify your landlord immediately if you discover a burst pipe or severe leak.
examples.zh: 若發現家中水管爆裂或嚴重漏水情況，切記務必第一時間主動知會房東前來修繕。

examples.en: The landlord returned the security deposit in full when the tenant moved out peacefully.
examples.zh: 當房客退租並完好點交房屋後，房東依約如數將押金全額退還給房客。

examples.en: Reliable tenants pay monthly rent punctually and maintain clean living spaces.
examples.zh: 優質守信的愛乾淨好房客每個月皆會準時匯交租金，並悉心維護屋況整潔。

examples.en: The property manager screened prospective tenants thoroughly before offering a lease.
examples.zh: 物業管理專員在正式簽訂租約前，會嚴謹審核每位潛在租客的信用背景與在職證明。

examples.en: Both landlords and tenants have legal rights clearly protected under housing tenancy laws.
examples.zh: 房東與房客雙方合法的租賃權益，在租賃專法中皆享有明確周全的法律保障。

examples.en: Read the residential lease contract carefully before signing and paying.
examples.zh: 在正式落筆簽署房屋租賃契約並支付款項前，請務必逐條詳閱租約條款。

examples.en: The commercial company signed a five-year lease for three floors in the new office tower.
examples.zh: 該跨國企業在新落成的摩天商辦大樓一口氣簽署了為期五年的三個樓層辦公室租約。

examples.en: The owner decided to lease out the ground floor storefront to a boutique bakery.
examples.zh: 屋主決定將位於一樓的黃金店面出租給一家精緻法式手工烘焙坊。

examples.en: Standard rental agreements in Taiwan require a two-month security deposit.
examples.zh: 台灣標準住宅定型化租賃契約普遍約定收取相當於兩個月租金的押金。

examples.en: Any damages beyond normal wear and tear may be deducted from the security deposit.
examples.zh: 任何超出正常合理使用折舊範圍的蓄意破壞損壞，皆可能自租賃押金中據實扣除。

examples.en: The tenant asked for an official written receipt upon paying the cash security deposit.
examples.zh: 房客在以現金交付租賃保證金押金時，主動要求房東開立正式的簽收收據存查。

words.definition: 獨立套房；開放式單身套房

examples.en: Young professionals enjoy renting cozy studio apartments close to tech hubs.
examples.zh: 年輕上班族偏好在離科技園區與商務核心區不遠處租一間採光良好的溫馨獨立套房。

examples.en: Her studio apartment features a combined living and sleeping area with a compact kitchenette.
examples.zh: 她的單身開放式套房融合了客廳與臥室機能，並附帶一組精緻迷你的小巧流理台廚房。

examples.en: Clever modular furniture maximizes available floor space inside a small studio apartment.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用多功能變形收納家具，能將小型獨立套房的每寸空間利用率發揮到淋漓盡致。

words.definition: 電梯大樓公寓；華廈社區 (Condo)

examples.en: Modern residential condominiums provide 24-hour security guards and elevators.
examples.zh: 現代化優質電梯大樓華廈社區提供二十四小時全天候保全警衛門禁與磁扣電梯。

examples.en: Buying a condominium in Taipei offers convenient underground parking and trash collection.
examples.zh: 在台北購置電梯大樓社區住宅，能享有便利的地下室專屬平面車位與免追垃圾車服務。

examples.en: The newly completed luxury condominium overlooks the lush greenery of Daan Forest Park.
examples.zh: 這棟嶄新落成的頂級豪宅電梯大樓坐擁大安森林公園無遮蔽的壯闊綠意景觀。

examples.en: Many families in central and southern Taiwan prefer spacious multi-story townhouses.
examples.zh: 許多中南部大家庭在置產時特別偏好產權獨立、附私家庭院車庫的寬敞透天厝。

examples.en: Their three-story suburban townhouse has a garage on the ground floor and a rooftop garden.
examples.zh: 他們座落於郊區的三層連棟透天別墅一樓規劃有室內車庫，頂樓則開闢了一座空中花園。

examples.en: Living in a detached townhouse eliminates complaints from downstairs neighbors about running footsteps.
examples.zh: 居住在獨門獨院的透天厝裡，完全不用擔心樓下鄰居前來抱怨小朋友奔跑的腳步聲。

words.definition: 房屋仲介經紀人；房仲 (Estate Agent)

examples.en: A licensed professional realtor showed us three three-bedroom apartments today.
examples.zh: 一位專業熱心的持照房仲經紀人今天帶領我們實地參觀了三間三房兩廳的優質物件。

examples.en: Working with an honest realtor helps first-time buyers navigate complex legal contracts safely.
examples.zh: 與誠懇信賴的專業房仲合作，能協助首購族安全無虞地審閱繁複的買賣定型化契約。

examples.en: The realtor researched neighborhood price history to help the seller set an attractive listing.
examples.zh: 房仲詳實調查了該社區過去實價登錄的歷史成交行情，協助屋主訂定合理的開價。

examples.en: The real estate agency charged a standard legal buyer commission fee.
examples.zh: 房屋仲介公司依照主管機關法定規範向買賣雙方合理收取標準仲介服務費佣金。

examples.en: Sales representatives earn a base monthly salary plus a ten percent sales commission.
examples.zh: 業務代表每個月除了享有保障底薪外，還能領取按成交業績抽成一成的業務佣金。

examples.en: Be sure to clarify the exact broker commission rate before signing the exclusive agency agreement.
examples.zh: 在簽署專任委託買賣契約書之前，務必事先確認清楚買賣雙方實際應負擔的佣金趴數。

examples.en: Schedule an afternoon house viewing to inspect natural interior sunlight.
examples.zh: 建議預約晴朗午後時段實地預約看屋賞屋，以便親自檢驗室內採光與通風對流。

examples.en: We attended a weekend private viewing of the newly listed loft apartment near the park.
examples.zh: 我們在週末參加了一場位於公園旁、剛開盤上市的挑高樓中樓物件的私人賞屋會。

examples.en: Bringing a small flashlight and measuring tape is helpful when conducting a detailed apartment viewing.
examples.zh: 在進行仔細的實地看屋時，隨身自備手電筒與捲尺能大幅方便勘查樑柱與暗處屋況。

words.definition: 坪（台灣房地產面積計算單位，約3.3平方公尺）

examples.en: The spacious master bedroom suite measures approximately eight ping (26.4 m²).
examples.zh: 這間寬敞方正的主臥大套房室內實坪面積約為八坪（約相當於 26.4 平方公尺）。

examples.en: Property listings in Taiwan clearly distinguish between total building ping and actual indoor ping.
examples.zh: 台灣房屋買賣物件資訊都會清楚載明權狀登記總坪數與室內主建物的實際室內實坪。

examples.en: An average single-family home in the residential district covers roughly thirty-five ping.
examples.zh: 該住宅重劃區內標準三房的家庭住宅，室內加上附屬建物約落在三十五坪左右。

words.definition: 房屋格局；動線配置；版面編排

examples.en: The efficient apartment layout features three square bedrooms and two full bathrooms.
examples.zh: 這間房屋格局方正採光極佳，規劃有標準三房兩廳兩衛，動線流暢毫不浪費空間。

examples.en: An open-concept kitchen and living room layout makes small urban flats feel much larger.
examples.zh: 開放式廚房與無走道公領域的格局規劃，讓都會中小坪數空間在視覺上更顯開闊通透。

examples.en: The graphic designer adjusted the magazine page layout to balance images and typography.
examples.zh: 美編設計師細心調整了雜誌版面編排佈局，使精彩攝影圖片與文字排版達成完美平衡。

words.definition: 房屋裝修；老屋翻新；修繕

examples.en: Comprehensive old-house renovation included replacing all plumbing and electrics.
examples.zh: 這場耗時數月的老屋翻新全室裝修工程徹底更換了全戶所有的水電老舊管線。

examples.en: The museum is temporarily closed for architectural renovation until next spring.
examples.zh: 該公立博物館因配合建築結構整修與內部修繕工程，暫停對外開放至明年春季。

examples.en: Setting aside a contingency buffer in your renovation budget protects against unforeseen repairs.
examples.zh: 在居家裝潢修繕預算中預留一成預備金，能從容因應拆除後意外浮現的追加修繕開銷。

words.definition: 室內設計；室內空間美學

examples.en: Minimalist Japandi interior design blends Nordic warmth with Japanese simplicity.
examples.zh: 融合北歐溫馨木質調與日式質樸美學的無印極簡風室內設計近年深受年輕人喜愛。

examples.en: We hired an interior design studio to create smart custom storage throughout our condominium.
examples.zh: 我們委託了一家專業室內設計公司，為全室電梯大樓量身規劃完善高機能的收納美學。

examples.en: Good interior design harmonizes natural lighting, airflow, color palettes, and daily functionality.
examples.zh: 卓越的室內空間設計能將天然採光、室內通風、配色層次與實用生活機能巧妙融為一體。

words.definition: 裝潢統包工頭；工程承包商

examples.en: Hire an experienced licensed contractor to manage demolition and carpentry teams.
examples.zh: 聘請口碑良好、信譽可靠的專業裝潢統包工程工頭來統籌調度泥作與木工師傅班底。

examples.en: The independent contractor submitted a detailed itemized quote before breaking ground.
examples.zh: 統包工程承包商在正式動工開拆前，先提交了一份詳盡列出各工種單價的估價單。

examples.en: Regular on-site communication with your general contractor ensures construction stays on schedule.
examples.zh: 定期與統包工地主任進行面對面現場溝通核對，能確保各施工工期按照既定進度推進。

examples.en: Demolition workers carefully removed non-loadbearing brick walls to open the space.
examples.zh: 拆除工程工班小心翼翼打除客廳與廚房之間非承重牆隔間，打造開闊開放式大空間。

examples.en: Building demolition permits must be acquired from city authorities before heavy machinery arrives.
examples.zh: 在大型重機械進場開挖拆除前，必須先依法向市府主管機關取得正式建築拆除執照。

examples.en: Workers wore industrial dust masks and ear protection during the noisy bathroom demolition.
examples.zh: 在敲除舊磁磚與清運廢土的噪音衛浴拆除工區中，師傅們均佩戴防塵面罩與降噪耳罩。

examples.en: Lightweight drywall partitions with sound-absorbing rockwool create quiet study rooms.
examples.zh: 填塞吸音岩棉的輕鋼架雙層石膏板輕隔間牆為孩子打造出安靜舒適的獨立書房空間。

examples.en: Glass sliding door partitions divide the master bedroom from the walk-in closet gracefully.
examples.zh: 鋁框長虹玻璃推拉門隔斷優雅地將主臥睡眠區與更衣室梳妝動線巧妙劃分開來。

examples.en: The open-plan office used low wooden partitions to give coworkers personal privacy.
examples.zh: 開放式辦公大廳採用矮木質屏風隔板，為每位員工營造出舒適不壓迫的獨立辦公隱私。

words.definition: 地板建材；木質地板鋪設

examples.en: Waterproof SPC laminate wood flooring was installed seamlessly throughout the flat.
examples.zh: 全室直鋪具備防水抗刮特性的優質超耐磨 SPC 石塑木地板，美觀且極易日常維護清潔。

examples.en: Natural teak hardwood flooring gives living rooms an inviting and luxurious warm feel.
examples.zh: 鋪設天然緬甸柚木實木地板賦予了寬敞客廳溫暖宜人且歷久彌新的頂級奢華質感。

examples.en: Ensure the concrete subfloor is level and dry before installing click-lock vinyl flooring.
examples.zh: 在拼接卡扣式石塑卡扣地板前，務必先確認下層水泥素地平整乾燥、無高低落差。

examples.en: Large-format matte porcelain tiles make the open kitchen look elegant.
examples.zh: 大尺寸消光霧面義大利進口石英地磚讓開放式廚房與玄關落塵區顯得沉穩典雅大器。

examples.en: Subway tiles laid in a classic herringbone pattern create a stylish bathroom shower wall.
examples.zh: 採用經典人字形拼接工法鋪貼的白色鐵道磚，打造出復古時尚的淋浴間特色主牆。

examples.en: Textured slip-resistant tiles were selected for the balcony floor to prevent falls in the rain.
examples.zh: 景觀陽台地面特地選用防滑係數高的止滑石英地磚，以防雨天濕滑不慎滑倒跌傷。

words.definition: 重新粉刷油漆；重新上漆

examples.en: Fresh white wall repainting instantly brightened up the dimly lit hallway.
examples.zh: 為全家牆面重新粉刷純白環保乳膠漆油漆，瞬間讓原本昏暗的走廊煥然一新明亮照人。

examples.en: The exterior facade repainting of the apartment complex restored its modern appearance.
examples.zh: 社區大樓外牆磁磚拉皮與防水晴雨漆的全面重新上漆，讓建築重現現代摩登風華。

examples.en: Professional surface sanding and patch filling are vital steps prior to final repainting.
examples.zh: 在進行最後一道面漆刷塗前，徹底進行牆面批土打磨平整是油漆工程至關重要的前置作業。

words.definition: 水電管線系統；衛浴配管工程

examples.en: Upgrading old galvanized plumbing to durable stainless steel pipes prevents rust.
examples.zh: 將四十年老舊鍍鋅鐵水管全數升級汰換為耐壓不銹鋼管，能徹底杜絕水管生鏽漏水。

examples.en: Faulty concealed plumbing beneath the floor tiles caused damp spots on downstairs ceilings.
examples.zh: 埋設在地磚下方暗處的給水配管施工瑕疵，導致樓下天花板出現大片壁癌濕氣水漬。

examples.en: Call a licensed technician to inspect your household gas and water plumbing every few years.
examples.zh: 建議每隔數年請合格的水電技師到府全面檢視家中的瓦斯與給排水水電管線系統。

examples.en: Certified electricians upgraded the main electrical breaker panel to 100 amperes.
examples.zh: 擁有甲級證照的專業水電師傅將全戶總配電盤電箱總安培數擴容升級至 100 安培。

examples.en: An experienced electrician added dedicated circuits for the high-power induction stove.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的水電師傅為廚房大功率 IH 電磁爐拉設了獨立的 220V 專用無熔絲迴路。

examples.en: Never attempt dangerous wiring modifications yourself; always consult a qualified electrician.
examples.zh: 絕不要自行冒險私接高壓強電配線；遇有配電需求請務必洽詢合格持照的水電技師。

examples.en: Applying multiple elastomeric coats ensures flawless bathroom waterproofing.
examples.zh: 在浴室濕區底層塗佈多道彈性水泥防水塗料，能確保衛浴防水工程滴水不漏萬無一失。

examples.en: Rooftop waterproofing needs regular maintenance and reapplying every five to seven years.
examples.zh: 頂樓露台的聚氨酯彈性防水漆層需要定期維護，建議每隔五至七年重新滾塗施作。

examples.en: Thorough flood testing for 48 hours is required to verify the success of waterproofing.
examples.zh: 在進行泥作貼磚前必須進行長達四十八小時的蓄水試水測試，以嚴格檢驗防水層品質。

examples.en: Professional thermal cameras detected the hidden bathroom pipe water leakage.
examples.zh: 抓漏達人運用高科技紅外線熱影像儀迅速揪出隱藏在牆壁深處的暗管水管漏水點。

examples.en: The gas company responded swiftly when neighbors reported a suspected fuel pipe leakage.
examples.zh: 當鄰居通報聞到濃重瓦斯氣味懷疑管線滲漏洩漏時，天然氣瓦斯公司迅速派員搶修。

examples.en: Untreated roof water leakage can damage reinforced concrete and cause concrete spalling.
examples.zh: 若長期放任屋頂裂縫漏水不予理會，水氣會滲蝕鋼筋導致嚴重的混凝土塊剝落結構損壞。

examples.en: Quality window soundproofing blocks street traffic noise during rush hours.
examples.zh: 打造高等級的隔音工程能將尖峰上下班時段馬路上呼嘯而過的大車噪音完全阻隔於窗外。

examples.en: The music producer installed acoustic soundproofing panels in his home recording studio.
examples.zh: 這位音樂製作人在自家宅錄錄音室四壁安裝了專業的高密度吸音降噪隔音吸音板。

examples.en: Flooring underlayment materials provide effective impact soundproofing against children running.
examples.zh: 木地板底下鋪設的高性能減震隔音墊，能有效阻隔小朋友奔跑跳躍產生的衝擊撞擊聲。

examples.en: Double-glazed airtight windows keep city traffic roar and typhoon winds outside.
examples.zh: 雙層膠合強化玻璃頂級氣密隔音窗能將戶外車水馬龍喧囂與颱風強烈狂風徹底隔絕。

examples.en: Store fresh roasted coffee beans inside an opaque airtight container to preserve their aroma.
examples.zh: 將新鮮烘焙好的莊園咖啡豆保存在不透光的單向排氣氣密罐中，能長保迷人甘醇風味。

examples.en: Installing heavy airtight doors effectively locks theater sound inside the cinema room.
examples.zh: 安裝厚重扎實的氣密防爆隔音門，能將家庭劇院震撼的低音砲音效完全鎖在影音室內。

words.definition: 系統櫃訂製；櫥櫃家具工程

examples.en: Custom floor-to-ceiling cabinetry maximizes storage capacity in small city flats.
examples.zh: 頂天立地的量身訂製客製化系統櫃將都會小宅的垂直收納空間效益發揮至極致。

examples.en: The kitchen cabinetry is crafted from European E0-grade moisture-resistant boards.
examples.zh: 全套歐化廚具系統櫥櫃皆採用符合歐洲頂級 E0 等級低甲醛防潮環保板材打造。

examples.en: Soft-close hinges and drawer slides ensure that the cabinetry closes quietly and smoothly.
examples.zh: 採用知名進口奧地利緩衝鉸鏈與抽屜滑軌，確保每次關閉系統門片時安靜無聲又順暢。

examples.en: Stain-resistant engineered quartz countertops are durable and easy to wipe clean.
examples.zh: 耐刮耐磨且抗油污滲透的進口人造石英石流理檯面，經久耐用且極易日常擦拭保養。

examples.en: Never place piping hot cast-iron skillets directly onto an acrylic solid surface countertop.
examples.zh: 剛起鍋滾燙的鑄鐵煎鍋切記不要直接擺放在人造壓克力實體檯面上，以免高溫燙傷留痕。

examples.en: The spacious kitchen island countertop serves double duty as a casual breakfast dining bar.
examples.zh: 寬敞大器的開放式中島吧檯檯面同時兼具備料輕食料理台與晨間溫馨早餐吧的多功能。

examples.en: A high-suction range hood is essential for high-heat Taiwanese stir-fry cooking.
examples.zh: 配備大吸力、深罩式的排油煙機能在大火快炒時秒速吸走油煙，保持居家空氣清新。

examples.en: Remember to clean or replace the grease filter on your range hood every few months.
examples.zh: 養成每隔數個月定期拆卸清洗或替換排油煙機不銹鋼集油網的良好廚房清潔習慣。

examples.en: Modern concealed range hoods retract seamlessly flush beneath custom upper cabinetry.
examples.zh: 當代隱藏式排油煙機在不使用時能完全收折收納於上方系統吊櫃下方，維持極簡美觀。

words.definition: IH 電磁感應爐；IH 爐

examples.en: Frameless induction cookers provide safe, flameless heating for modern kitchens.
examples.zh: 無明火且加熱神速的平面式嵌入型 IH 感應爐是現代無明火安全美型廚房的人氣標配。

examples.en: An induction cooker heats ferrous pots directly using electromagnetic magnetic fields.
examples.zh: IH 爐利用高頻電磁感應渦電流原理直接加熱鍋底金屬，熱轉換效率極高且表面不燙手。

examples.en: Cleaning an induction cooker is as simple as wiping a smooth, flat sheet of ceramic glass.
examples.zh: 清潔平面 IH 爐面無比輕鬆寫意，只需拿抹布輕輕擦拭整片平整的光滑黑晶微晶玻璃即可。

examples.en: Installing a built-in dishwasher saves valuable evening family leisure time.
examples.zh: 家中安裝一台大容量嵌入式自動洗碗機徹底免除飯後洗碗辛勞，大幅提升家庭幸福感。

examples.en: Modern dishwashers sanitize tableware using high-temperature water jets and hot air drying.
examples.zh: 當代全嵌式洗碗機透過攝氏七十度高溫強力水柱噴淋與熱風烘乾，達成全方位高溫除菌。

examples.en: Make sure to scrape large food remnants off plates before loading them into the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 在把碗盤餐具依序擺入洗碗機洗碗籃架前，請先將盤面大塊骨頭殘渣刮除乾淨。

words.definition: 衛浴面盆浴櫃；梳妝台；虛榮

examples.en: The wall-hung bathroom vanity incorporates generous storage for toiletries.
examples.zh: 懸空壁掛式的現代衛浴下嵌式面盆浴櫃提供了充裕的收納空間以妥善擺放洗沐備品。

examples.en: An illuminated LED mirror was mounted above the double-sink bathroom vanity.
examples.zh: 雙面盆寬敞衛浴浴櫃正上方，客製安裝了一面具備觸控除霧功能的環形 LED 美妝化妝鏡。

examples.en: She sat down at her bedroom vanity table to apply skincare creams and moisturizer.
examples.zh: 她安適地坐在臥室典雅的梳妝台前，細心塗抹夜間保濕乳霜與精華液滋潤肌膚。

examples.en: Heated smart bidet toilet seats provide comfort during cold winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬日寒冬清晨坐上具備溫水沖洗與暖座功能的智慧免治馬桶座，備感溫暖貼心舒適。

examples.en: Using a bidet with warm water spray is hygienic, soothing, and reduces toilet paper use.
examples.zh: 使用免治馬桶溫水柔膚沖洗不僅潔淨衛生、舒緩溫和，更能大幅減少衛生紙砍樹浪費。

examples.en: Many travelers fall in love with electronic bidets when visiting hotels in Tokyo and Taipei.
examples.zh: 許多歐美觀光客在入住東京與台北的現代化飯店時，對功能一應俱全的免治馬桶讚不絕口。

examples.en: High-end property management maintains building cleanliness and security 24/7.
examples.zh: 優質專業的物業管理服務全天候守護社區治安門禁並維持公共區域一塵不染。

examples.en: The property management company oversees mechanical elevator maintenance and fire safety.
examples.zh: 社區物業管理團隊全權統籌監督大樓電梯機械巡檢、自來水塔清洗與消防申報安檢。

examples.en: Residents voiced satisfaction with the friendly front-desk staff hired by property management.
examples.zh: 全體住戶對物業管理公司派駐在一樓大廳親切專業的秘書服務團隊表達了高度肯定。

words.definition: 社區管理費；公共管理費

examples.en: Monthly condominium maintenance fees cover elevator servicing and trash disposal.
examples.zh: 每月按坪數繳納的社區公共管理費涵蓋了電梯例行保養、社區保全與垃圾清運開銷。

examples.en: Buildings with swimming pools and concierge services generally charge a higher maintenance fee.
examples.zh: 規劃有全天候溫水室內泳池與頂級物業秘書櫃台的社區，每坪管理費通常相對較高。

examples.en: The homeowners committee presented a transparent financial audit of the maintenance fee fund.
examples.zh: 社區管委會在區分所有權人住戶大會上，公開透明公布了全年度公共管理費公積金收支明細。

words.definition: 保全警衛人員；大樓管理員

examples.en: The friendly security guard greets residents and receives incoming courier deliveries.
examples.zh: 親切和藹的大樓保全警衛熱情向住戶問好，並有條不紊代收每日各大物流黑貓包裹。

examples.en: Night-shift security guards patrol the underground parking garage to verify that all doors are locked.
examples.zh: 值大夜班的保全巡邏人員每隔兩小時定時巡視地下室各層停車場，確認各安全逃生門緊閉。

examples.en: Visitors must present identification to the lobby security guard before going upstairs.
examples.zh: 訪客在搭乘電梯上樓探訪住戶前，必須主動向一樓迎賓櫃台的保全警衛出示證件實名登記。

words.definition: 智取置物櫃；包裹快遞櫃

examples.en: Residents retrieve online parcels anytime using self-service smart package lockers.
examples.zh: 社區住戶下班返家後隨時可透過手機簡訊密碼至一樓智慧智取包裹櫃自助領取網購。

examples.en: Gym members store their backpacks and gym shoes in keyless electronic lockers.
examples.zh: 健身俱樂部會員在更衣室內將隨身後背包與運動球鞋妥善鎖入電子密碼置物櫃中。

examples.en: Courier delivery drivers drop boxes directly into the designated secure locker.
examples.zh: 宅急便外送物流司機將包裹條碼感應刷入指定的智慧安全存件箱格中，省時省力。

words.definition: 資源回收分類；整理挑選

examples.en: Residential basement recycling stations make daily trash sorting effortless.
examples.zh: 大樓地下室規劃完善的二十四小時資源回收集中場讓住戶免追垃圾車、輕鬆落實分類。

examples.en: Diligent household sorting of paper, plastic, and food scraps conserves valuable resources.
examples.zh: 居家日常落實紙類、塑膠寶特瓶與廚餘的細部回收分類，能將寶貴資源永續循環再利用。

examples.en: Automated optical sorting machines help modern recycling centers separate plastics by resin type.
examples.zh: 自動化光學分揀機台能協助現代資源回收處理中心依照塑料材質種類精準分離各類回收物。

words.definition: 公共設施；生活便利配備 (公設)

examples.en: Building amenities include a heated swimming pool, modern gym, and rooftop lounge.
examples.zh: 該豪華指標建案的公共設施公設包含了溫水景觀泳池、重訓健身房與空中花園交誼廳。

examples.en: Hotel amenities such as plush robes, high-speed Wi-Fi, and espresso machines delight guests.
examples.zh: 頂級飯店房間內提供的厚織親膚浴袍、極速無線網路與義式膠囊咖啡機深受房客喜愛。

examples.en: When evaluating properties, consider whether the community amenities justify the public area ratio.
examples.zh: 在挑選中古屋或預售屋時，應冷靜評估各項社區公設配備是否物有所值、符合自身日常需求。

words.definition: 房屋抵押貸款；房貸；抵押

examples.en: First-time buyers applied for a 30-year preferential home mortgage loan.
examples.zh: 年輕首購族夫妻向公股銀行正式申辦了為期三十年期的青年安心成家優惠首購房貸。

examples.en: The young couple calculated their monthly income to ensure they could comfortably service the mortgage.
examples.zh: 這對年輕新婚夫妻精準盤點每月家庭總收入，以確保薪資足以輕鬆負擔每月房貸還款。

examples.en: Paying off the 20-year mortgage early freed up substantial cash for retirement investments.
examples.zh: 提前五年提早清償長達二十年的房屋抵押貸款，讓夫妻倆騰出了豐沛的現金投入退休儲蓄。

examples.en: Saving a 20% down payment is the first major step toward homeownership.
examples.zh: 踏實存下相當於總房價兩成的購屋自備款頭期款是實現買房成家夢想的第一大步。

examples.en: They lived frugally for six years to accumulate the required down payment for their flat.
examples.zh: 他們省吃儉用努力奮鬥了整整六年，終於如願存到了心目中理想成家小窩的足額購屋頭期款。

examples.en: Once the down payment is wired to escrow, the home purchase agreement becomes legally binding.
examples.zh: 一旦購屋自備款頭期款正式全數匯入履約保證專戶，不動產買賣契約便具備完全法律效力。

examples.en: Low mortgage interest rates make monthly home loan repayments manageable.
examples.zh: 享有長期優惠低利房貸利率讓成家青年每個月的房貸本息攤還金額維持在寬裕合理的範圍。

examples.en: The central bank raised its benchmark interest rate to curb persistent consumer inflation.
examples.zh: 中央銀行全體理監事會議決議宣布升息半碼，藉由調高基準重貼現率以抑制頑固通膨。

examples.en: Borrowers compare fixed interest rate options against variable rate packages before locking loans.
examples.zh: 房貸借款人在正式對保簽約前，通常會反覆精算比較固定利率與浮動利率方案的長期利息差異。

words.definition: 房屋建物所有權狀；地契權狀

examples.en: The land registry office issued the official real estate title deed upon settlement.
examples.zh: 地政事務所於交屋過戶結清完稅當日正式核發蓋有鋼印的建物與土地所有權狀。

examples.en: Keep your property title deed stored safely alongside other irreplaceable legal certificates.
examples.zh: 請將名下房產的不動產所有權狀地契妥善收藏保管在防潮保險箱中，切勿隨意摺疊遺失。

examples.en: The conveyancer verified that the title deed was completely clean and unencumbered by liens.
examples.zh: 承辦地政士代書在簽約前徹底查核土地登記謄本，確認該權狀產權清白、絕無任何二胎抵押。

examples.en: Municipal property taxes are levied annually on residential and commercial buildings.
examples.zh: 地方稅捐稽徵處每年五月份會依法針對名下各類住宅與商用不動產課徵房屋稅。

examples.en: Homeowners can apply for self-use residential property tax rates to reduce annual tax burdens.
examples.zh: 設籍自住的自住型屋主可向稅務局申請適用千分之十二的自用住宅優惠稅率以節省稅金。

examples.en: Remember to pay property taxes before the statutory deadline to avoid late payment penalties.
examples.zh: 請記得在法定期限截止日前如期繳納年度地價稅與房屋稅，以避免產生滯納金加徵罰款。

words.definition: 房地產增值；資產增值；升值

examples.en: Infrastructure developments like new metro lines drive long-term property appreciation.
examples.zh: 新建捷運通車與科學園區擴建等重大交通基礎建設能強勁帶動周邊房地產長期增值。

examples.en: Historically, real estate investment offers a dependable hedge against inflation through capital appreciation.
examples.zh: 從歷史長線來看，房地產資產配置能透過實體資產的穩健資本增值有效抵禦通貨膨脹。

examples.en: Strong neighborhood school districts are proven catalysts for steady home value appreciation.
examples.zh: 明星滿額雙語學區周邊住宅向來被公認為推升房價長期穩定抗跌與保值增值的強大推手。

examples.en: The bank performed an on-site property valuation to approve the mortgage limit.
examples.zh: 銀行房貸專員偕同專業鑑價師親赴房屋現場進行實地鑑價，以核定最高房貸額度。

examples.en: The independent appraiser provided a detailed market valuation report based on recent sales.
examples.zh: 獨立不動產估價師依據周邊鄰近區域最新實價登錄成交行情，出具了詳盡的市場鑑價報告。

examples.en: A higher bank valuation allowed the buyers to secure an eighty percent loan-to-value ratio.
examples.zh: 銀行給予較高且合理的鑑價評估結果，讓買方順利爭取到了高達八成成數的成家房貸額度。

examples.en: Government subsidies provide preferential loan rates for first-time homebuyers.
examples.zh: 政府新青安房貸政策提供極具競爭力的利率補貼，全方位力挺年輕首購族成家置產。

examples.en: Savvy homebuyers visit neighborhoods during both daytime and heavy rainstorms to check drainage.
examples.zh: 聰明用心的購屋者往往會在晴朗白天與暴雨豪雨過後分別實地走訪社區，確認有無漏水積水。

examples.en: First-time homebuyers should budget extra funds for deed transfer taxes, brokerage fees, and appliances.
examples.zh: 第一次買房的首購族切記要額外預留一筆規費預算，以支應契稅代書費、房仲服務費與基礎家電。

words.definition: 擁有自有住宅；成家置產擁房率

examples.en: Achieving homeownership gives young families a deep sense of permanence and security.
examples.zh: 順利成家置產、擁有屬於自己溫暖的一方天地，為年輕家庭帶來無比踏實的歸屬感與安定感。

examples.en: High housing price-to-income ratios in major metropolises make homeownership difficult for youths.
examples.zh: 首都各大都會區過高的房價所得比讓現代許多剛出社會打拼的年輕世代感嘆買房門檻過高。

examples.en: Favorable government savings accounts and lending terms help turn the dream of homeownership into reality.
examples.zh: 善加運用政府推出的青年自購住宅優惠貸款政策與補貼方案，有助於將買房成家的夢想化為現實。
